attributes.board_name: Nevada State Board of Dental Examiners

rules.accepted_credit_types: No Board approval needed for: CPR courses; courses approved by ADA (CERP), ADHA or AGD (PACE); nationally recognized dental or medical specialty associations; universities/colleges; Joint Commission-accredited hospitals. Other providers need Board approval
rules.audit_note: CE audits; keep CE records at least 3 years.

topics.who: Dentists registered to dispense controlled substances: misuse/abuse of controlled substances, opioid prescribing or addiction
SBIRT (Screening, Brief Intervention and Referral to Treatment) course; proof due at renewal if not yet submitted
New licensees, within 2 years after initial licensure (NRS 631.342)

rules.notes: At least 30 of 40 hours clinical. Max 50% home/online/self-study, volunteering or journal study. Current CPR required. Moderate sedation/general anesthesia permit: 6 h anesthesia/sedation study every 2 years. Biennial renewal by June 30.
